gate_contracts.outcome: run event chain integrity verified — hash-chain intact, state consistent with events, gate results aligned, run IDs bound, no bypass indicators
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Verifies hash-chain integrity, state consistency, gate alignment, run ID binding, and bypass detection across the entire run. Exit code 0 = all checks passed, 1 = integrity issues found.
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Run `node scripts/verify-run.mjs --project-root <path>` independently. The script checks: (1) hash-chain integrity with no tampering/insertion/deletion, (2) state consistency where completed phases match advance events, (3) gate result alignment for validated phases, (4) run ID binding across all artifacts, (5) bypass detection for enter-without-advance or missing events. N/A for unguarded workflows with no guard-events.jsonl.

gate_contracts.outcome: truth verification confirms artifact claims match reality
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Cross-validates all artifact claims against reality: re-runs tests, checks e2e evidence files exist, validates receipt tool identities, checks quality review depth, and compares scorecard claims against verified results. Exit 0 = TRUTH-PASS, exit 1 = TRUTH-FAIL.
